strings.zh: 由此向东——七之岛,{NEWLINE}由此向北——六之岛。
strings.en: East: Seven Island{NEWLINE}North: Six Island
strings.notes: Alto Mare Waters (#0-#138); #139-#163 are Mt. Mortar / Route 42 lines (bank shared by those maps).

strings.zh: 救生员呆呆地望着岸上的九尾,{NEWLINE}眼神中既有欣慰又有落寞。
strings.en: The lifeguard gazes blankly at the{NEWLINE}Vulpix on the shore, his eyes full of{CLEAR}both relief and loneliness.
strings.notes: D-0745 (D-1496/D-1572, approved by the user 2026-10-06): zh 九尾 (Ninetales) corrected to Vulpix; #2-#5 and every cry in script 965 are Vulpix (PlayCry 37), no Ninetales in the scene.

strings.zh: 啊……你好。{NEWLINE}刚刚我的注意力都在六尾身上,{CLEAR}没有注意到面前还站着人。{CLEAR}我是这一带的救生员,{CLEAR}这只六尾是我和乘龙冒着生命危险{CLEAR}从海潮中救下来的。{CLEAR}看到它现在活蹦乱跳的样子,{CLEAR}我就觉得我的付出都是值得的。
strings.en: Ah... hello. I was so focused on Vulpix{NEWLINE}that I didn’t notice someone standing in{CLEAR}front of me.{SCROLL}I’m the lifeguard around here. Lapras{NEWLINE}and I risked our lives to save this{CLEAR}Vulpix from the tide. Seeing it bouncing{CLEAR}around like this now, I feel it was all{CLEAR}worth it.
strings.notes: #2-#70: lifeguard, Vulpix and the drowned Charmander. Branches: #13 (take revenge on Lapras) vs #14 (not his fault); revenge-quest path #38-#48 / #59-#65.

strings.zh: 六尾『Vuuuu——pi！
strings.en: Vulpix: Vuuuu-pi!

strings.zh: 乘龙『Laaa——pra！
strings.en: Lapras: Laaa-pra!

strings.zh: 六尾『Vuuuu——pi！{NEWLINE}乘龙『Laaa——pra！{SCROLL}两只精灵互相蹭了蹭对方。
strings.en: Vulpix: Vuuuu-pi!{NEWLINE}Lapras: Laaa-pra!{SCROLL}The two Pokémon nuzzled each other.

strings.zh: 嘿嘿,这两只精灵感情还不错吧？
strings.en: Heh heh. These two get along pretty{NEWLINE}well, don’t they?

strings.zh: 看到小火龙的主人能够看开,{NEWLINE}我心中的一块石头也算是落地了。
strings.en: Seeing Charmander’s owner come to{NEWLINE}terms with it has finally taken a weight{CLEAR}off my heart.

strings.zh: 小火龙的死与你有关？
strings.en: Charmander’s death involves you?
strings.notes: menu width fix (follow-up 1): was 'Charmander’s death had to do with you?'

strings.zh: 真是两只可爱的精灵
strings.en: What cute Pokémon

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『嗯,两只精灵都很可爱呢。
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Mm, they’re both really cute.

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『我看你是一位{NEWLINE}非常有爱心的救生员,{CLEAR}可是有人说你害死了他的小火龙,{CLEAR}这到底是怎么回事？
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: You seem like a lifeguard with{NEWLINE}a big heart. But someone says you got{CLEAR}his Charmander killed. What happened?

strings.zh: 啊……这……,{NEWLINE}也可以说是确有其事吧。{CLEAR}有一次大涨潮时,{CLEAR}海岸边正好有一只家养小火龙{CLEAR}和一只野生六尾在玩耍,{CLEAR}这时候一个大浪过来,{CLEAR}两只精灵都被卷进了海里。{CLEAR}当时我和小火龙的主人都在附近,{CLEAR}小火龙的主人不会游唦,{CLEAR}就拜托我去救小火龙。{CLEAR}但我的位置离六尾比较近,{CLEAR}于是我和乘龙就先把六尾救上了岸。{CLEAR}等我们回头再去救小火龙的时候,{CLEAR}小火龙的生命之火{CLEAR}已经被海水彻底扑灭了……{SCROLL}那天小火龙的主人{NEWLINE}抱着小火龙冰冷的身体{CLEAR}失声痛哭的样子,{CLEAR}在我脑海中萦绕至今……
strings.en: Ah... Well... I suppose you could say{NEWLINE}it’s true. Once, during a big high tide,{CLEAR}a pet Charmander and a wild Vulpix were{CLEAR}playing on the shore. A huge wave came{CLEAR}in and swept both Pokémon out to sea.{SCROLL}Charmander’s owner and I were both{NEWLINE}nearby. Its owner couldn’t swim, so he{CLEAR}begged me to save Charmander. But I{CLEAR}was closer to Vulpix, so Lapras and I{CLEAR}brought Vulpix ashore first.{SCROLL}By the time we turned back to save{NEWLINE}Charmander, the sea had put out its{CLEAR}flame of life for good...{SCROLL}That day, Charmander’s owner held its{NEWLINE}cold body and wept uncontrollably. I{CLEAR}still can’t get that sight out of{CLEAR}my head...
strings.notes: zh 游唦 read as 游泳 (swim).

strings.zh: 用你的乘龙给小火龙偿命
strings.en: Lapras’s life for Charmander’s!
strings.notes: menu width fix (follow-up 1): was 'Your Lapras will pay for{NEWLINE}Charmander’s life'; ext-review LD-001

strings.zh: 看来这件事也不能怪你
strings.en: I guess it isn’t your fault

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『原来是一场意外。{NEWLINE}我觉得你已经尽到了救生员的职责,{CLEAR}小火龙的死错不在你,{CLEAR}你不必太过自责。
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: So it was an accident. I think{NEWLINE}you did your duty as a lifeguard.{CLEAR}Charmander’s death isn’t your fault.{CLEAR}You don’t need to blame yourself{CLEAR}so much.

strings.zh: 谢谢你……
strings.en: Thank you...

strings.zh: 看你那副软弱的样子,{NEWLINE}我就知道报仇的事不能指望你。{CLEAR}还是我亲自来吧！
strings.en: One look at how weak you are, and I{NEWLINE}knew I couldn’t count on you for my{CLEAR}revenge. I’ll do it myself!

strings.zh: 你挡在我面前算怎么回事,{NEWLINE}是想阻止我报仇吗？
strings.en: What do you think you’re doing,{NEWLINE}standing in my way? Trying to stop{CLEAR}my revenge?

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『小火龙的事{NEWLINE}确实非常让人伤心,{CLEAR}但请你冷静地想一想,{CLEAR}那其实是一场意外,{CLEAR}你不该迁怒救生员和他的乘龙。
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: What happened to Charmander{NEWLINE}is truly heartbreaking. But please,{CLEAR}think about it calmly. It was an{CLEAR}accident. You shouldn’t take it out on{CLEAR}the lifeguard and his Lapras.

strings.zh: 小火龙落水确实是意外,{NEWLINE}但如果他放弃六尾{CLEAR}先去救我的小火龙,{CLEAR}小火龙一定能活下来！{CLEAR}我无法接受这样的结果,{CLEAR}我要他的乘龙以命抵命！
strings.en: Charmander falling in the sea was an{NEWLINE}accident, sure. But if he’d given up on{CLEAR}Vulpix and saved my Charmander first,{CLEAR}Charmander would definitely have lived!{CLEAR}I can’t accept that. I want his Lapras{CLEAR}to pay with its life!

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『从尊重生命的角度讲,{NEWLINE}大家的生命都是平等的,{CLEAR}没有谁比谁高贵。{CLEAR}救生员优先救更容易施救的精灵,{CLEAR}并没有什么问题。{CLEAR}请你控制一下情绪……
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Out of respect for life, every{NEWLINE}life is equal. No one is worth more than{CLEAR}anyone else. There’s nothing wrong with{CLEAR}a lifeguard saving the Pokémon that’s{CLEAR}easier to save first. Please try to{CLEAR}control yourself...

strings.zh: 够了！你不要再说了……！
strings.en: Enough! Don’t say another word...!

strings.zh: ……{SCROLL}呜……{SCROLL}呜呜呜……你说的道理我都懂,{NEWLINE}但是如果他先救小火龙的话……{CLEAR}呜呜呜……
strings.en: ...{SCROLL}Hic...{SCROLL}Waaah... I understand everything{NEWLINE}you’re saying. But if only he’d saved{CLEAR}Charmander first... Waaah...

strings.zh: 六尾『Vuuuu——pi……{SCROLL}六尾蹭了蹭中年男子。
strings.en: Vulpix: Vuuuu-pi...{SCROLL}Vulpix nuzzled the middle-aged man.

strings.zh: 六尾……小火龙的死你也有份！！！
strings.en: Vulpix... You’re to blame for{NEWLINE}Charmander’s death too!!!

strings.zh: 六尾『Vuuuu——Vuuuu——！{SCROLL}六尾泪眼汪汪地看着中年年子。
strings.en: Vulpix: Vuuuu-Vuuuu-!{SCROLL}Vulpix looked at the middle-aged man{NEWLINE}with teary eyes.
strings.notes: zh 中年年子 read as 中年男子 (also #48).

strings.zh: 小火龙,你是小火龙！？
strings.en: Charmander... Is that{NEWLINE}you, Charmander?!

strings.zh: 不、不,你是六尾,不是小火龙。{NEWLINE}是我眼花了……
strings.en: No, no. You’re Vulpix, not Charmander.{NEWLINE}My eyes are playing tricks on me...

strings.zh: 对不起,请听我说一句。{NEWLINE}那天没能赶得及救下小火龙{CLEAR}我也非常自责。{CLEAR}如果给您带来了悲伤的情绪,{CLEAR}就请冲我发泄吧。{CLEAR}您和精灵都是无辜的,{CLEAR}请放过它们和您自己吧。
strings.en: I’m sorry, but please hear me out. I{NEWLINE}blame myself terribly for not making it{CLEAR}in time to save Charmander that day. If{CLEAR}I’ve caused you grief, then please take{CLEAR}it out on me. You and the Pokémon are{CLEAR}innocent. Please spare them, and spare{CLEAR}yourself too.
strings.notes: RV005: meaning: 放过它们和您自己 = spare them and yourself; ‘let yourself go’ meant something else in English

strings.en: Ah... Sigh...

strings.zh: 你们说的道理我都懂,我都懂……{SCROLL}如果上天非要安排六尾{NEWLINE}代替小火龙活在这个世界上,{CLEAR}也就只能这样了……
strings.en: I understand what you’re saying. I do,{NEWLINE}I do...{SCROLL}If heaven insists that Vulpix go on{NEWLINE}living in this world in Charmander’s{CLEAR}place, then I suppose that’s how it has{CLEAR}to be...

strings.zh: 这只六尾还没有被人收服,{NEWLINE}如果您不嫌弃的话,{CLEAR}就请收服它……
strings.en: No one has caught this Vulpix yet. If{NEWLINE}you don’t mind, please catch it...

strings.zh: 不必了,这么活泼可爱的精灵,{NEWLINE}不太适合现在的我。{CLEAR}你就好好照顾它吧,{CLEAR}让它代替小火龙好好活下去。
strings.en: No need. A Pokémon this lively and cute{NEWLINE}isn’t right for me as I am now. You take{CLEAR}good care of it. Let it live on well in{CLEAR}Charmander’s place.

strings.zh: 没问题,交给我吧！
strings.en: Of course! Leave it to me!

strings.zh: 你是个出色的救生员,{NEWLINE}继续在这个岗位上加油吧……
strings.en: You’re an excellent lifeguard. Keep up{NEWLINE}the good work here...

strings.zh: 啊,好！好的！
strings.en: Ah, yes! I will!

strings.zh: 也谢谢你坚持原则,{NEWLINE}阻止了我的冲动行为,{CLEAR}这个送给你,算是我的一点心意吧。
strings.en: And thank you for sticking to your{NEWLINE}principles and stopping me from doing{CLEAR}something rash. Please take this. It’s{CLEAR}just a small token of my thanks.

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『因为你的选择,{NEWLINE}造成了小火龙丧命。{CLEAR}我今天受小火龙主人的委托,{CLEAR}来杀你的乘龙抵命！
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Because of your choice,{NEWLINE}Charmander lost its life. Today, at the{CLEAR}request of Charmander’s owner, I’ve{CLEAR}come to kill your Lapras to pay for it!

strings.zh: 啊！你不要伤害我的乘龙！
strings.en: Ah! Don’t hurt my Lapras!

strings.zh: 啊！你！
strings.en: Ah! You!

strings.zh: 不……这件事不怪乘龙,{NEWLINE}请你不要伤害它,{CLEAR}有什么仇什么怨冲我来吧！
strings.en: No... This isn’t Lapras’s fault. Please{NEWLINE}don’t hurt it. If you’ve got a grudge,{CLEAR}take it out on me!

strings.zh: 杀了乘龙,{NEWLINE}才是对你最好的惩罚！
strings.en: Killing Lapras is the best punishment{NEWLINE}for you!

strings.zh: 你是那只小火龙的主人！
strings.en: You’re that Charmander’s owner!

strings.zh: 谢谢你帮我打败了这个救生员,{NEWLINE}不然以我的实力还真是拿他没办法。{CLEAR}这是给你的谢礼,{CLEAR}后面的复仇就交给我吧。
strings.en: Thank you for beating that lifeguard{NEWLINE}for me. With my skills, I couldn’t have{CLEAR}done anything to him. Here’s your{CLEAR}reward. Leave the rest of the revenge{CLEAR}to me.

strings.zh: 现在就是我的复仇时刻了,{NEWLINE}你好好体会下心爱的精灵{CLEAR}死在眼前是个什么滋味吧！
strings.en: Now it’s my turn for revenge! Now you’ll{NEWLINE}get to feel what it’s like to watch your{CLEAR}beloved Pokémon die before your eyes!

strings.zh: 住手！住手啊！
strings.en: Stop! Please, stop!

strings.zh: 六尾『Vuuuu——Vuuuu——！{SCROLL}六尾向中年年子哀嚎着。
strings.en: Vulpix: Vuuuu-Vuuuu-!{SCROLL}Vulpix wailed at the middle-aged man.
strings.notes: zh 中年年子 read as 中年男子 (as #26)

strings.zh: 我真的非常非常抱歉,{NEWLINE}那天没能赶得及救下小火龙{CLEAR}我也是自责无比。{CLEAR}如果给您带来了悲伤的情绪,{CLEAR}就请冲我发泄吧。{CLEAR}您和精灵都是无辜的,{CLEAR}请放过它们和您自己吧。
strings.en: I’m truly, truly sorry. I blame myself{NEWLINE}terribly for not making it in time to{CLEAR}save Charmander that day. If I’ve{CLEAR}caused you grief, then please take it{CLEAR}out on me. You and the Pokémon are{CLEAR}innocent. Please spare them, and spare{CLEAR}yourself too.
strings.notes: RV005: meaning: 放过它们和您自己 = spare them and yourself; ‘let yourself go’ meant something else in English

strings.zh: 那天六尾和小火龙{NEWLINE}在岸边玩的非常开心,{CLEAR}它们两个一定成为了好朋友。{CLEAR}您的小火龙一定也不希望{CLEAR}看到您伤害六尾吧？
strings.en: That day, Vulpix and Charmander were{NEWLINE}having so much fun playing on the shore.{CLEAR}They must have become good friends.{CLEAR}Surely your Charmander wouldn’t want{CLEAR}to see you hurt Vulpix either?

strings.zh: 小火龙……
strings.en: Charmander...

strings.zh: 六尾『Vuuuu——pi……{SCROLL}六尾舔了舔中年男子。
strings.en: Vulpix: Vuuuu-pi...{SCROLL}Vulpix licked the middle-aged man.

strings.zh: 呜呜呜……为什么,{NEWLINE}为什么你这么像小火龙……
strings.en: Waaah... Why? Why are you so much{NEWLINE}like Charmander...

strings.zh: 其实道理我都懂,我都懂……{NEWLINE}我就是不能接受,{CLEAR}为什么偏偏是我的小火龙……{CLEAR}为什么……
strings.en: I know. I understand, I do... I just{NEWLINE}can’t accept it. Why did it have to be{CLEAR}my Charmander... Why...

strings.zh: 这只六尾还没有被人收服,{NEWLINE}如果您觉得它像小火龙,{CLEAR}就请用它代替……
strings.en: No one has caught this Vulpix yet. If{NEWLINE}you think it’s like Charmander, then{CLEAR}please let it take{CLEAR}Charmander’s place...

strings.zh: 不必了,小火龙是小火龙,{NEWLINE}六尾是六尾,{CLEAR}毕竟还是不同的精灵。{CLEAR}况且这么活泼可爱的精灵,{CLEAR}不太适合现在的我。{CLEAR}你就好好照顾它吧,{CLEAR}让它代替小火龙好好活下去。
strings.en: No need. Charmander is Charmander, and{NEWLINE}Vulpix is Vulpix. They’re different{CLEAR}Pokémon, after all. Besides, a Pokémon{CLEAR}this lively and cute isn’t right for me{CLEAR}as I am now. You take good care of it.{CLEAR}Let it live on well in{CLEAR}Charmander’s place.

strings.zh: 唉……没错,{NEWLINE}这些可爱的精灵也都是生命,{CLEAR}尤其是六尾这舔人的感觉{CLEAR}跟小火龙那么像……
strings.en: Sigh... You’re right. These cute{NEWLINE}Pokémon are lives too. Especially the{CLEAR}way Vulpix licks you... It’s so much{CLEAR}like Charmander...

strings.zh: 我啊……就是个无能的主人,{NEWLINE}不仅没能保护好小火龙,{CLEAR}还想要伤害其他人和精灵,{CLEAR}是我太冲动了。
strings.en: Me... I’m just a useless owner. Not only{NEWLINE}did I fail to protect Charmander, I{CLEAR}wanted to hurt other people and{CLEAR}Pokémon too. I was too rash.

strings.zh: 我曾经有一只小火龙,{NEWLINE}它是我最珍惜的口袋妖怪。{CLEAR}可是却被群岛的一个救生员给害死了。{CLEAR}我想要给小火龙报仇,{CLEAR}但又担心打不赢那个救生员。{CLEAR}我看你挺厉害的样子,{CLEAR}你能替我去杀了救生员的乘龙,{CLEAR}为我的小火龙报仇吗？
strings.en: I once had a Charmander. It was my{NEWLINE}most treasured Pokémon. But a{CLEAR}lifeguard in the islands got it killed.{SCROLL}I want to avenge Charmander, but I’m{NEWLINE}afraid I can’t beat that lifeguard. You{CLEAR}look pretty strong. Will you go kill that{CLEAR}lifeguard’s Lapras for me, and avenge{CLEAR}my Charmander?

strings.zh: 我来主持公道
strings.en: I’ll see justice done

strings.zh: 不关我事
strings.en: Not my business

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『如果真是有人{NEWLINE}害死了你的精灵,{CLEAR}我会为你主持公道的。
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: If someone really got your{NEWLINE}Pokémon killed, I’ll see that justice is{CLEAR}done for you.

strings.zh: 谢谢你愿意帮忙。{NEWLINE}那个救生员就在三之岛东侧的海域,{CLEAR}他最亲密的精灵是一只乘龙,{CLEAR}你帮我解决那只乘龙就好了。
strings.en: Thank you for helping. That lifeguard is{NEWLINE}in the waters east of Three Island. His{CLEAR}closest Pokémon is a Lapras. Just take{CLEAR}care of that Lapras for me.

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『这……我会去看看的。
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Well... I’ll go take a look.

strings.zh: 那个救生员就在三之岛东侧的海域,{NEWLINE}他最亲密的精灵是一只乘龙,{CLEAR}你帮我解决那只乘龙就好了。
strings.en: That lifeguard is in the waters east of{NEWLINE}Three Island. His closest Pokémon is a{CLEAR}Lapras. Just take care of that Lapras{CLEAR}for me.

strings.zh: 唉……往事历历在目,却已物是人非。
strings.en: Sigh... The past is still so vivid, but{NEWLINE}everything has changed.

strings.zh: 对不起小火龙,{NEWLINE}我的能力就到此为止了,{CLEAR}没有办法为你报仇了……
strings.en: I’m sorry, Charmander. This is as far as{NEWLINE}I can go. I can’t avenge you...

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『够了,你冷静冷静吧！{NEWLINE}你失去伙伴的悲痛我们都能理解,{CLEAR}但伤心的并不只是你,{CLEAR}救生员看到你那痛苦的样子,{CLEAR}他也非常难过。{CLEAR}你们都是热爱精灵的人,{CLEAR}请不要再有伤害别人的想法了。
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Enough! Calm down! We all{NEWLINE}understand the pain of losing your{CLEAR}partner. But you’re not the only one{CLEAR}who’s hurting. Seeing you suffer like{CLEAR}this hurts the lifeguard too. You both{CLEAR}love Pokémon. Please stop thinking{CLEAR}about hurting others.

strings.zh: 如果上天非要安排六尾{NEWLINE}代替小火龙活在这个世界上,{CLEAR}也就只能这样了……
strings.en: If heaven insists that Vulpix go on{NEWLINE}living in this world in Charmander’s{CLEAR}place, then I suppose that’s how it has{CLEAR}to be...

strings.zh: 六尾,你是在安慰我吗？
strings.en: Vulpix, are you trying to comfort me?

strings.zh: 由此向北——五之岛,{NEWLINE}由此向西——四之岛。
strings.en: North: Five Island{NEWLINE}West: Four Island

strings.zh: 嘿嘿,是你呀。{NEWLINE}我按照你的建议,{CLEAR}围着水都群岛走了好大一圈。{CLEAR}最近我感觉这颗蛋一动一动的,{CLEAR}是不是快要孵化了啊？
strings.en: Heh heh, it’s you. I took your advice{NEWLINE}and walked all the way around the Alto{CLEAR}Mare Islands. Lately, this Egg has been{CLEAR}moving a little. Is it about to hatch?
strings.notes: #72-#117: girl hatches Manaphy; treasure-hunting brothers; #90 male / #91 female player.

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『哦？蛋自己会动了？{NEWLINE}那岂不是就要孵化了？
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Oh? The Egg is moving on its{NEWLINE}own? Doesn’t that mean it’s about{CLEAR}to hatch?

strings.zh: 你看,刚刚这颗蛋是不是又动了？
strings.en: Look! Didn’t the Egg just move again?

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『没错,确实是动了！
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Yes, it definitely moved!

strings.zh: 玛纳菲『Maaa——na！
strings.en: Manaphy: Maaa-na!

strings.zh: 孵化了孵化了！孵化出口袋妖怪了！
strings.en: It hatched! It hatched! A{NEWLINE}Pokémon hatched!

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『这只精灵是……？{NEWLINE}我好想没怎么见过啊。
